items.title: Visa (V) Hands Over 6 Million Documents As DOJ Debit Card Case Drags On
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has delivered 6 million documents to the US Department of Justice as part of an ongoing government debit card lawsuit. The discovery phase in the case has been extended until 2027, with a trial currently expected in 2028. The scale and duration of the proceedings highlight continued regulatory scrutiny of Visa's debit card practices.
